title: Collecting treasure takes the nearest one
description: The player opens a chest beside a gold bar, and its emerald lands between him and the bar. He steps onto the gold bar, which could be collected, and nothing is: the emerald, nearer, has to wait out its first moments first. Once it can be collected he takes it, and the gold bar the step after.
